title: 2025 HMMT February Geometry Problem 8
statement: Let \(A B C D\) be an isosceles trapezoid such that \(C D > A B = 4\) . Let \(E\) be a point on line \(C D\) such that \(D E = 2\) and \(D\) lies between \(E\) and \(C\) . Let \(M\) be the midpoint of \(\overline{{A E}}\) . Given that points \(A\) , \(B\) , \(C\) , \(D\) , and \(M\) lie on a circle with radius 5, compute \(M D\) .

solutions.text:
Let \(D^{\prime}\) be the reflection of \(D\) across \(M\) . Then, \(A D E D^{\prime}\) is a parallelogram. Hence, \(D^{\prime}A = 2\) , so \(D^{\prime}B = 6\) . Thus, if \(D^{\prime}M = M D = x\) , then Power of a Point at \(D^{\prime}\) gives \(x\cdot (2x) = 2\cdot 6\) , so \(x = \sqrt{6}\) .

Remark. The radius of the circle is unnecessary.
